Temperature: 300 °C Duration: Not reported; Unresolved source discrepancy: Results p.6 says 300 °C for 30 min; Figure 5 caption says 300 °C for 20 min in flowing argon; Methods p.9 says 300 °C for 20 min in flowing nitrogen. Duration and atmosphere are not harmonized. Environment: Not reported; Conflicting flowing nitrogen (Methods) and flowing argon (Figure 5). Tube furnace in Methods. Authored conceptual stage illustration; not measured apparatus or particle structure.
